name: ekod
description: Repository coding agent with guarded edits and native review for a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

ekod.endpoint.description: HTTPS API base URL (origin or /v1). Configure your endpoint before connecting.

ekod.model.description: Selected model; also the fallback when discovery fails.

ekod.streamResponses.description: Receive model responses incrementally. Disable for endpoints that do not support streaming. Complete actions are validated before execution.

ekod.debugRejectedResponses.description: Save up to three rejected model responses per task in private extension storage for debugging. The configured API key is redacted, but source code and other sensitive text may remain. Disabling stops new captures; existing diagnostic files remain until deleted.

ekod.pesterVersion.description: Auto selects the newest installed supported Pester version. Choose 4 or 5 for a suite that requires that major version. Missing selected versions are reported rather than silently substituted.

ekod.validationExecutionPolicy.description: Inherit workstation execution policy by default. RemoteSigned applies only to validation child processes, permits local unsigned tests, and does not override Group Policy or change machine settings.

ekod.installValidationModules.description: Allow one CurrentUser installation attempt for missing selected Pester/PSScriptAnalyzer modules from PSGallery per task. Requires network access; failures are reported as reduced validation coverage.

ekod.permissionMode.description: Review is read-only. Workspace confirms destructive edits. Full access allows guarded repository edits and validation without operation confirmations.

ekod.autoOpenDiffs.description: Automatically open native diff tabs for proposed changes and after editing tasks. Explicit review still opens diffs when this is off.

ekod.compatibilityMode.description: User message (default) embeds instructions and context in a user message without response_format. Standard uses system messages and JSON mode. Action validation and permissions are unchanged.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --out ekod.vsix
